newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: S.Korea's Yukong to shut RFCC, MTBE plants Aug-Sep.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong to shut RFCC, MTBE plants Aug-Sep.

text.p: South Korean oil refiner Yukong Ltd plans to shut down its 50,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) residue fluid catalytic cracker (RFCC) and 6,000-bpd methyl tertiaty butyl ether (MTBE) plant during August 2-September 10, an industry source said on Thursday.
He said the RFCC which produces mainly gasoline and liquid petroleum gas will be shut for maintenance.
Its associated MTBE plant, which takes its butane feedstock from the RFCC, will have to be closed simultaneously.
Yukong has the the country's largest refinery with a 810,000-bpd capacity.
